assembly_findings: Closed beam sleeve/captured core requires explicit insert-molding or split-shell fabrication sequence; no insertion path established by coincident cavity.
Splitcollet has two removable halves: preassemble finger/beam, route wire before final clamp tightening, then solder; actual access/tool envelopes must be validated.
Collet neck geometry is not a shear/creep/load proof; material, preload and retention remain unqualified.
M1 caps with clearance to head/nut need declared attachment to lug or mechanical retention; cavity containment alone does not retain them.
M2 board stack requires original PCB/collar and washer interfaces, no newholes; recorded source2.2mm holes do not prove torque/structural capacity.
